body.intent: Fix A workflow that declares 'autonomy signoff owner' is signed off autonomously anyway. The repo's docs workflow (#425) declares signoff = owner (rhiza workflow describe docs: 'autonomy signoff owner'), yet run 01M73CQ4D71CW038ZBNSQB1SJF (Concepts polish, PR #426) logged 'step signoff: signed off under rule autonomous' and went on to land; run 01M73CQ3TCG0TVWWR8ZV62VAE8 (README, PR #427) is headed the same way. Settings: rhiza.autonomy.signoff = auto (default, project); the daemon runs --autonomous. The milestone's Decisions require the owner to sign off each page, so a workflow's declared owner stage must win over the default/--autonomous (or the docs workflow is not honoured). Held by converting PRs #426 and #427 to draft so ship merge cannot merge them; the owner signs off on the PRs by hand.
